The Library of Babel

Short story by Jorge Luis Borges

First published in Spanish in 1941, The Library of Babel imagines the universe as an immense library made of identical hexagonal rooms containing books with every possible combination of characters.

Author: Jorge Luis Borges

Collected in: The Garden of Forking Paths, Ficciones

Themes: infinity, meaning, authorship, chance, total knowledge
